essential_step: For any finite poset with x||y, Pred(x) subseteq Pred(y), and Succ(y) subseteq Succ(x), defining D=Pred(y)\Pred(x) and U=Succ(x)\Succ(y), the exact identity is 2 Pr(x<y)-1 = Pr((exists d in D:x<d) OR (exists u in U:u<y)). In width at most three only maximal D and minimal U matter, at most two on each side. In the inherited strict delayed-predecessor branch D is a nonempty chain, so a no-balanced/no-internal-descent crossed endpoint has at most three canonical fringe events whose union exceeds 1/3; therefore U is nonempty and one canonical outward fringe pair has minority probability >1/9 and <1/3, hence majority probability between 2/3 and 8/9. If Min(U) is singleton, the minority bound improves to >1/6 and majority <5/6.
sharp_two_gap: When D={d}, U={u}, 2 Pr(x<y)-1 = alpha+beta-eta with alpha=Pr(x<d), beta=Pr(u<y), eta=Pr(x<d and u<y). For the fleet02/B19 adversary A=336, B=352, H=84, R=604, E=1810, so 2Nxy-E=604, 3R-E=2 and the endpoint excess is exactly 1/(3E)=1/5430, the first possible positive integer step.
